description: Which GPS, serial-number and owner EXIF tags an image carries (keys only) — Lists which privacy-relevant EXIF tags exist in a JPEG, TIFF, PNG (eXIf) or WebP (EXIF) image, for an agent that is about to publish, upload or forward a photo. Reports tag ids and names for GPS, body and lens serial numbers, camera owner, artist, unique image id, device, software, timestamps and thumbnails; values are never returned. Input is the image as base64 (up to 96 KiB, enough for the meta

data.description: Padded base64 of the image file or its first 96 KiB (the metadata block must be inside it).

forbid.description: Categories whose presence fails the check. Default gps, serial, owner.

name: exif-report
